title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
statement_short: Given a sorted rotated array nums of unique elements, return the minimum element of this array. You must write an algorithm that runs in O(log n) time.
constraints: n == nums.length, 1 <= n <= 5000, -5000 <= nums[i] <= 5000, all values are unique, nums is rotated between 1 and n times
hint: Rotated sorted array with unique elements and strict O(log n) requirement calls for binary search comparing mid to right endpoint.
why_not: Right: Binary Search compares nums[mid] with nums[right] to discard the sorted half and narrow in on the inflection pivot point in O(log n) time. Not Two Pointers: Scanning pointers linearly finds the minimum in O(n) time, violating O(log n). Not Monotonic Stack: Stack tracking handles next-smaller elements in O(n) time and space. Not Heap / Priority Queue: Min-heap insertion takes O(n) time and auxiliary space.
